description: Kevin manually switched to the app's 'double temperature setting' via the official app (not via our CLI). Raw GET /status confirms this corresponds to operation_mode='KeepMode' at the wire level -- previously only a guessed HVACMode.AUTO bucket entry in climate.py, now live-confirmed.
app_confirmed: Kevin set this himself via the app; app UI shows 'double temperature setting'.
notes: This was a GET only, captured via a raw one-off script bypassing EoliaStatus.from_dict() entirely (to make sure no unmodeled field was being silently dropped) -- confirms the full raw field set still matches what models.py already parses, no hidden second-temperature field present.

RESOLVED 2026-09-23: the range is not in /status at all. It lives in a separate resource, GET /devices/{id}/customsettings -> double_mode_temp {status, high, low}. Live read with Kevin's app-set range: {"status": true, "high": 28, "low": 23}. See docs/findings.md 'KeepMode / double temperature setting'.

wind_direction reset to 0 and wind_direction_horizon reset to 'auto' when entering KeepMode -- possibly this mode forces auto airflow regardless of prior fan/swing settings. Not yet confirmed whether this is mode-driven or coincidental.
ai_control stayed comfortable_econavi (carried over from prior steps) -- KeepMode and ai_control appear independent, as expected from the data model.
